ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:0.55 ratio of high-intensity (white/off-white) to low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal regions of both lobes contain large, contiguous high-intensity regions. These are surrounded by low-intensity margins. Mottling is concentrated along the trailing edges and within the transition zone to the central low-intensity peduncle region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Clear V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 112 degrees; depth is shallow relative to total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge exhibits low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations. More pronounced, irregular topography is visible at the extreme distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a consistent convex curve from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Occasional small, isolated low-intensity circular focal spots within the white fields, but no high-density circular clusters indicative of active barnacle colonization are detected.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible on the high-intensity field of the right lobe, appearing as rake-like marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregular tissue loss and ragged edges observed at the distal tips of both lobes.
